name: io.github.tpequegnot/careercraft
description: Parse a resume, rank job postings against it with explained scores, and draft grounded cover letters — entirely on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: CAREERCRAFT_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Directories the server may read resumes from. Defaults to the user's home directory.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama daemon URL for writing cover letter prose. Without it the server returns a grounded brief for the host model to write from instead.

environmentVariables.name: CAREERCRAFT_OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Which pulled Ollama model to use.
